entry.name: launchers
entry.label: Quick Launch: the programs' desktop files (applications:firefox.desktop or file URLs); shown from the 1998 look on

entry.name: quickLaunchDock
entry.label: Where the Quick Launch sits: "left", after the Start button, or "right", at the taskbar's end before the tray

entry.name: quickLaunchWidth
entry.label: The Quick Launch's width in pixels; -1 fits all its buttons. Buttons that do not fit go behind a chevron

entry.name: maxButtonWidth
entry.label: The longest a window's button may be, in pixels; 0 takes the look's own (95px in 1995, 160px after)

entry.name: quickLaunch
entry.label: Quick Launch: "yes", "no", or "auto" for the look's own (from the 1998 look on)

entry.name: look
entry.label: The look: "1995" (no Quick Launch, 95px task buttons), "1998" or "2000" (a pixel more before the Quick Launch)
